findings.evidence: ci-live.js:4-5 `var root = document.querySelector("[data-ci-live]"); if (!root) return;`; ci-live.js:139,171 do the `img.loc-graph` refresh; grep finds no `ci-live.js` or `ci/manifest` loader anywhere in web/ apart from ci-live.js itself.
findings.fix: Keep loading a chart-only refresher: either a minimal root plus a trimmed `ci-live.js` with the count headline removed, or move the chart refresh into `ci-operations.js`. Add a browser assertion that a chart's `src` updates from the manifest.
findings.issue: The removed `liveStatus` block was the only `<script src="static/ci-live.js">` and the only `[data-ci-live]` root. `ci-live.js` returns early without that root, so the CI chart images (`img.loc-graph`) are no longer swapped for the newest manifest SVGs. This breaks the PR's own claim to 'Preserve independent chart refresh'.

findings.evidence: style.css:497-522 `.ci-live`, `.ci-live-counts`, ...; scripts/test_ci_live_browser.mjs:6 loads ci-live.js and asserts on `[data-ci-counts]`/`[data-ci-backlog]`; scripts/test_content_ci_separation.py:33 lists 'ci-live-tests.yml'.
findings.fix: Delete the count/backlog code, its `.ci-live*` CSS and the tests that exercise it in this PR. Keep or relocate only the chart-refresh part (see the previous finding).
findings.issue: The removed live-count widget's code is still present: the count/backlog rendering in ci-live.js, the `.ci-live*` CSS, scripts/test_ci_live_browser.mjs, .github/workflows/ci-live-tests.yml and the `ci-live-tests.yml` allowlist entry. Nothing on the page uses any of it now.

summary: Deleting `liveStatus` removes the only loader and root for `ci-live.js`, so the live chart refresh silently stops, despite the PR saying it is preserved. The removed widget's script, CSS, test and workflow are still in the repo, used only by their own test.
